progressiveHints.text: Choose one situation where you would naturally use Nなら / い-adjective + ければ / Vたら; do not write the whole sentence yet.
Build the sentence in parts: choose the content first, then check the form that carries give practical guidance from a topic, preference, or event condition.
Compare your form, meaning, and neutral advice with the worked model. Change the content so the response is your own.

retryFeedback.diagnostic: Check the form and meaning again. A common mix-up is this: なら takes up a topic, ければ evaluates an adjective condition, and たら follows an event
